description: This Java class handles the reactivation of email campaigns in the system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands via processCommand method, and delegates the reactivation logic to EmailCampaignWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ReactivateEmailCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles commands to reactivate email campaigns by delegating to the email campaign service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reactivation command by calling the email campaign service to reactivate the specified email campaign.
